# Baldrick Boards

> Pixel, relay and interactive lighting controllers — manuals and docs for makers.

Prefer the Markdown manuals below for LLM context. They are the source content for each board manual (same material as the HTML docs and PDF downloads).

## Manuals (Markdown)

- [Baldrick8 Manual](https://www.baldrickboard.com/en/boards/baldrick8/manual.md)
- [Baldrick17 Manual](https://www.baldrickboard.com/en/boards/baldrick17/manual.md)
- [BaldrickSwitchy Manual](https://www.baldrickboard.com/en/boards/baldrickswitchy/manual.md)
- [BaldrickDMX Manual](https://www.baldrickboard.com/en/boards/baldrickdmx/manual.md)
- [BaldrickInput1 Manual](https://www.baldrickboard.com/en/boards/baldrickinput1/manual.md)
- [BaldrickInput8 Manual](https://www.baldrickboard.com/en/boards/baldrickinput8/manual.md)
- [BaldrickSignals Manual](https://www.baldrickboard.com/en/boards/baldricksignals/manual.md)
- [BaldrickBadge Manual](https://www.baldrickboard.com/en/boards/baldrickbadge/manual.md)
